channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Justin Zanik | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Justin Zanik from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Koby Altman on Justin Zanik
item.description:
Cleveland Cavaliers president of basketball operations Koby Altman said.

“He has an incredible motor. And you can trust Justin. You talk about sensitive topics with him, you show your hand a little bit in negotiations, and you know that's never going anywhere beyond you and him.”

Koby Altman on Justin Zanik, Apr 1, 2024. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Walker Kessler on Justin Zanik, Will Hardy
item.description:
“Well, I was actually working out at the practice facility in Utah. I was working out, and JZ (Justin Zanik) comes out on the court and says, ‘Walker, stop. I need you to take this call.’ So I was kinda freaking out. I was like, ‘I don’t know what’s about to happen. I’m about to get traded?’Everything was going in my head, and he said, ‘It’s Coach Will Hardy.’ I was like, ‘Oh, OK.’ So I took the phone, and coach was like, ‘Hey, bud. What you doing?’ I was like, ‘I’m working out coach.’ He was like, ‘Well, just wanna say congrats on making the USA team.’ And I was like, ‘Oh!’ I definitely was kinda speechless, but they voiced their congrats, and here I am.”

Walker Kessler on Justin Zanik, Will Hardy, Aug 13, 2023. Source: TalkBasket.

item.title: Ryan Smith on Justin Zanik
item.description:
Ryan Smith:

“I checked in [Monday] night and [Tuesday] morning, and I think Danny and Justin [Zanik] are doing a great job. I trust them and we trust them with 100% confidence. … The good news is, there’s a lot of phenomenal coaches in the NBA. “… Danny set [the timeline] up in the press conference. That was not my timeline — he was pretty direct on what that timeline would be. That’s what he’s here for — he’s here to lead, and my job is to empower him. … I’m really not [involved with early interviews], to be honest with you. I believe that you hire the best and you empower ’em. I don’t think there’s a better basketball brain than Danny, he’s definitely on the Mount Rushmore of NBA executives.”

Ryan Smith on Justin Zanik, Jun 22, 2022. Source: Salt Lake Tribune.

item.title: Danny Ainge on Justin Zanik
item.description:
Eric Walden:Danny Ainge:

“I'm not gonna be the guy that's running the day to day. That's gonna be Justin. I'm happy to communicate with him. I can be a sounding board for him. … This is going to take some time to develop.”

Danny Ainge on Justin Zanik, Dec 15, 2021. Source: Twitter @tribjazz.

item.title: Danny Ainge on Justin Zanik
item.description:
Eric Walden:Danny Ainge:

“The roster is strong. It's a really good team. … I'm not sure what needs to be done, but we'll look with Justin's team, and with Quin, and figure out what we need. But it's a dang good team.”

Danny Ainge on Justin Zanik, Dec 15, 2021. Source: Twitter @tribjazz.

item.title: Mike Conley on Justin Zanik, Rudy Gay
item.description:
Eric Walden:Mike Conley, on talking to Rudy Gay to come to the Utah Jazz:

“After I signed my deal, Justin [Zanik] and everybody told me to call up Rudy, so I became a recruiter in a sense.… I couldn't be more excited. He's a good friend of mine, our families are really close.”

Mike Conley on Justin Zanik, Rudy Gay, Aug 9, 2021. Source: Twitter @tribjazz.

item.title: Quin Snyder on Dennis Lindsey, Justin Zanik, Ersan Ilyasova, Bojan Bogdanovic, Georges Niang
item.description:
Ben Anderson:Quin Snyder on finding a player in Ersan Ilyasova who brings similar traits to Bogdanovic and Niang:

“Dennis and Justin and our group wouldn't have looked at someone you couldn't plug and play. I think the one thing we've been really conscious of is the chemistry of the team.”

Quin Snyder on Dennis Lindsey, Justin Zanik, Ersan Ilyasova, Bojan Bogdanovic, Georges Niang, Mar 11, 2021. Source: Twitter @BensHoops.

item.title: Steve Starks on Dennis Lindsey, Justin Zanik
item.description:
“We are excited for these promotions as they further enable Dennis to provide executive leadership and overall strategic vision for Jazz basketball operations and give Justin the opportunity for greater impact on our organization. As one of the brightest young executives in the league, Justin will be responsible for the day-to-day operations. Their leadership allows us to work collectively toward our championship goals,”

Steve Starks on Dennis Lindsey, Justin Zanik, May 10, 2019. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Wesley Edens on Justin Zanik
item.description:
Charles F. Gardner:Bucks owner Wes Edens on hiring assistant GM Justin Zanik:

“We feel like we added a lot of depth to the organization.”

Wesley Edens on Justin Zanik, Jun 17, 2016. Source: Twitter @cf_gardner.
